contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DIVVS AVGVSTVS VESPASIANVS ; R/ PONTIF [---]M

Silver coin. Commemorative denarius for Vespasian (69-79), possibly mint of Rome issue of 80-81 but not described in RIC vol. 2 pages 123-124 with this reverse. Obverse description: Craggy bull-necked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: DIVVS AVGVSTVS VESPASIANVS [retrograde]. Reverse description: Figure draped seated right on cushioned seat with vertical sceptre and diagonal sprig. Reverse…
